svg.title: Which Browser Use do I need?
svg.desc: Choose who runs the agent, then choose a browser. 1: the fully hosted V4 agent runs in Browser Use Cloud with a cloud browser included; send POST /api/v4/runs and get the result and files back. 2: the Browser Use CLI lets your existing agent, such as Claude Code, Codex or Hermes, drive your local Chrome by default, or a cloud browser after browser-use auth login. 3: the open-source Python library runs the agent in your own code with a local browser, or a cloud browser with Browser(use_cloud=True). 4: the Browser API gives you only a cloud browser to drive over CDP. 5: Profile Sync copies selected cookies from your local Chrome into a cloud profile when you run it.
